summary: Frontend-only testing for BERSINAR POS hardware integrations (USB barcode scanner + Bluetooth printer). All 6 scenarios in the review request passed. Admin login OK, product grid renders 12 products, non-decimal product click adds to cart, cash checkout completes and Receipt modal shows. Barcode scanner simulation (rapid synthetic KeyboardEvents + Enter) correctly auto-adds matching SKU product to cart WITHOUT any click (cart-total went from Rp 0 to Rp 42.000, cart-item-<id> appeared). Unknown barcode shows 'tidak ditemukan' toast and cart stays empty. Manual slow typing in pos-search is NOT hijacked (value='test' preserved). printer-toggle in navbar shows 'Browser tidak mendukung Bluetooth' toast under headless Chrome and app stays functional. Receipt modal exposes data-testid=receipt-bt-print-btn; clicking it with no printer connected shows 'Printer Bluetooth belum terhubung' toast and does not crash the app.
critical_code_review_comments: POS.js barcode listener uses capture=true on window keydown and preventDefault() when gap<35ms — works well but note: when scanner streams keys and the search box is focused, preventDefault blocks only the fast-stream chars (good). The slow-manual path is correctly non-blocking (test 4 confirmed).
handleScan matches by (sku || barcode) case-insensitively using exact equality — this is correct and avoids partial collisions.
printer.js gracefully handles missing navigator.bluetooth via isSupported(); Receipt bt-print-btn gates on getState().connected before calling print(). No crash paths observed.
Minor: scanner buffer resets on gap>80ms but does not have an upper bound on buffer length (unbounded growth if an attacker holds a key). Low risk — recommend capping at 64 chars.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded products (SKU-4D715C Air Mineral 600ml).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scanner simulation technique that works reliably: page.evaluate(sku => { for (ch of sku) window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:ch,bubbles:true})); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); }). The listener is on window with capture=true. Web Bluetooth is unavailable in the automation browser — only error paths can be verified. All data-testid attributes exist as documented in review_request.
